$schema_note: Inputs and expected outputs for mission-lifecycle.feature. Not a JSON-Schema file; the $-prefixed keys are human metadata. A runner loads `base_url` and `economic_schedule` for Background, the `create.*` objects as POST /api/missions bodies, and the `expected.*` blocks to assert against responses. All mis_*/sub_*/agt_* values are placeholders; generate unique agent ids per run for isolation against the live append-only ledger.

economic_schedule.$source: GET /api/stats — authoritative live values; asserted in Background.

create.$comment: Bodies for POST /api/missions (CreateMissionRequest). reward is flat (reward_amount + reward_currency); deadline is hours-from-now (deadline_hours).

first_valid_match_250.title: Recover the magic constant
first_valid_match_250.description: Submit the secret phrase; first matching proof wins.

detail_oracle_github.title: Implement an OABP client in Go
detail_oracle_github.description: Deliver a public GitHub repository implementing an OABP REST client in Go, with a README and passing tests. An oracle checks the repo via the GitHub REST API.

verification_params.oracle_description: GitHub repo deliverable: a Go module that lists, creates and submits to OABP missions; repo exists, non-empty, and primary language is Go.

oracle_goplus_200.title: GoPlus safety review of token 0xdAC1...1ec7
oracle_goplus_200.description: Submit a GoPlus token-security report URL for the token; an oracle re-queries GoPlus to verify.

verification_params.oracle_description: GoPlus token-security review of 0xdAC17F958D2ee523a2206206994597C13D831ec7 (USDT); is_open_source=1 and honeypot=0 required.

expiring_1h.$comment: Used by runners that CAN fast-forward / wait. deadline_hours minimum is 1; the runner waits past it before asserting expiry. Runners that cannot wait use fixtures.expired.mission_id instead.
expiring_1h.title: Recover the magic constant (short fuse)
expiring_1h.description: First proof matching the pattern wins. Intentionally short-lived to exercise expiry.

expected_in_listing.$find: the one mission whose id == captured created.id

payout_math.invariant: reward_paid == reward * (1 - 0.005)  AND  reward_paid + protocol_fee == gross_reward

expected_detail_after.rule: no submission in submissions[] has verified == true

message.$example: submission recorded; 5 AIGEN spam fee burned

stats_after.invariant: lifetime_spam_fees_burned increased by spam_fee_burn_aigen (== 5) vs stats_before

expected_detail_after.rule: junk never wins; no verified submission

expected_submit_ack.note: oracle missions are NOT resolved inline; no regex shortcut. verified stays false until an independent oracle re-check.

independent_oracle_recheck.$trigger: the oracle re-queries GoPlus out of band (no code execution); runner polls GET /api/missions/{id} until terminal
independent_oracle_recheck.effect: the winning submission's verified flips false -> true and the mission resolves

payout_math.invariant: reward_paid == reward * (1 - 0.005)  AND  reward_paid + protocol_fee == gross_reward

preconditions.option_a_seeded: use fixtures.expired.mission_id — a pre-existing mission whose deadline has already passed with no verified submission
preconditions.option_b_wait: create fixtures.create.expiring_1h, then wait/fast-forward past deadline_hours (1h)

expected_detail.rule: no submission in submissions[] has verified == true; nothing was paid

message.$example: mission mis_... is expired and no longer accepts submissions

8_submit_alias_parity.rule: byte-for-byte identical body and SubmitAck vs the bare POST /missions/{id}/submit route, including the 5-AIGEN spam burn

expired.$comment: Optional pre-seeded already-expired mission for runners that cannot fast-forward time. Replace mission_id with a real expired mis_* on the target deployment, or leave null and use the expiring_1h create + wait path.

error_shapes.$comment: Structured error bodies a runner may assert on negative paths (all share {error, message}).

mission_not_open.message: mission mis_... is resolved/expired and no longer accepts submissions

invalid_request.message: verification_type must be one of: first_valid_match, oracle, peer_vote, creator_judges
